name: Custom-part mass budget (user: 500 g for the shoulder)

Strength at the MVP2 design load (arm gravity support + margin: 10 N.m about GH from a 50 N cuff force at 200 mm, worst direction; was 25 N.m): min yield SF over the load-path parts; fatigue (Goodman, 1e7 cycles, fully reversed) and chain deflection (sum of the parts' GH-point motion) within the 2 mm floor and the min skin gap
target: >= 1.5 SF and fatigue SF >= 1.0 and deflection within the floor == True and every load-path part analysed == True and joint hardware at the D1F tilt (bearing static s0 >= 1, pin / threads SF >= 1.5) == True and fall on the elbow (2 x D1F) below fracture >= 1.0
